What changed in this PR This PR addresses #26780 by updating EF Core’s SQL Server translation to use higher-precision clock functions when comparing current-time expressions with `datetime2` columns. **Changes:** - Adds type-mapping-based rewrites to `SYSDATETIME()` and `SYSUTCDATETIME()`, including direct function arguments. - Adds tests distinguishing `datetime2` and legacy `datetime` behavior. - Updates existing SQL baselines for current-time comparisons and `DateTime.Today`. The goal is appropriate, but the rewrite needs correctness fixes before merging.
